 How to watch Clemson vs Syracuse
 Date: Saturday, November 7, 2026
 Time: 12 PM EDT
 Channel: ESPN2
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Syracuse is on a hot streak in the Atlantic Coast Conference and has back-to-back wins under its belt for the first time in more than a year as it hosts Clemson on Saturday. The Orange knocked former No. 19 SMU out of the AP rankings following a 30-27 upset last weekend to go 2-4 in the conference and finally inject some life into its season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Clemson moved to 3-2 in the ACC (5-3 overall) following a rivalry win over Florida State last time out, where freshman quarterback Tait Reynolds exploded with two touchdown passes after going four games without. The tight end duo of Olsen Patt-Henry and Christian Bentancur ended with one TD catch apiece, while Reynolds also crossed over for his second rushing score of the season.
 Syracuse's senior quarterback, Steve Agneli, also recorded a pass-rush scoring double of his own in the win over SMU. However, it was the nine points contributed from sophomore kicker Tripp Woody that also had a key impact, setting a new personal best for field goals in a single game in his college career.
 Dabo Swinney's Clemson total offense currently ranks 114th in the nation and averages 183.4 passing yards per game (115th in NCAA), significantly lower than the 221.6 passing yards Syracuse allows on average (85th). On the other hand, Clemson's total defense ranks 39th but could still encounter issues against an Orange offense now averaging 436.4 yards per game and showing a lot of promise.
